title.ko: 혼합 조건문과 암시된 조건: if I had ... I would be · but for · were it not for · otherwise · supposing
title.en: mixed conditionals and implied conditions: if I had ... I would be, but for, were it not for, otherwise, supposing

explain.ko: 혼합 조건문은 과거의 조건이 현재의 결과에 영향을 줄 때 씁니다. 형식은 if + 과거완료, would + 동사원형입니다. 반대로 현재의 상태가 과거의 결과에 영향을 줄 때는 if + 과거, would have + 과거분사를 씁니다. if 없이도 but for, were it not for, otherwise, supposing, provided that 같은 표현으로 조건을 암시할 수 있고, had he known처럼 도치해 더 격식 있게 만들 수 있습니다.
explain.en: Mixed conditionals are used when a past condition affects a present result. The form is if + past perfect, would + base verb. When a present state affects a past result, use if + past simple, would have + past participle. Conditions can also be implied without if through but for, were it not for, otherwise, supposing and provided that, and inversion such as had he known makes the style more formal.

notes.ko: 혼합 조건문은 시간 표지(now, today, by now)와 함께 쓰면 의미가 분명해집니다.
notes.en: Time markers such as now, today and by now make mixed conditionals clear.

notes.ko: had he known처럼 도치하면 if가 생략되고 격식이 높아집니다.
notes.en: Inversion like had he known drops if and raises formality.
But for is followed by a noun phrase.

prompt.en: Write four sentences about a past choice and its present result, using mixed conditionals and but for / otherwise.

task.model: If I had gone to graduate school, I would be a researcher now. But for my senior's advice, I would have chosen a job. I am content with this work now. Still, I had to learn more in time; otherwise I wouldn't be here.

model_trans.ko: 그때 대학원에 진학했다면 지금 연구자가 되어 있을 거예요. 하지만 선배의 조언이 없었다면 저는 취업을 선택했을 거예요. 지금은 이 일이 만족스러워요. 다만 시간을 더 배워 두었어야 해요. 그렇지 않으면 이 자리에 없었을 거예요.
model_trans.en: If I had gone to graduate school, I would be a researcher now. But for my senior's advice, I would have chosen a job. I am content with this work now. Still, I had to learn more in time; otherwise I wouldn't be here.
